Name: Papayahunter's Portrait Mod -- Bachelors and Bachelorettes
Author: papayahunter
Description:
[color=#f4cccc][size=6]Papayahunter's Portrait Mod [font=Arial](Bachelors/Bachelorettes edition)[/font]

[/size][/color]Almost exactly a year ago, I first put pen to tablet with the intention of making this mod. Now, after a year of trial and error, the first part is ready for public download.

I love everything about Stardew and the og ConcernedApe style, but at the same time, I couldn't keep looking at Sebastian with Bang-blindness. Somebody needed to move his bang.
I drew the characters with inspiration from their older portraits throughout history (hence Maru's brown hair) and my own style changes (Elliott's outfit)﻿, so hopefully they feel familiar, but a little more life-like.

[size=6]How to install[/size][size=3] [/size][size=6]:[/size]
[size=2](copied from the portraiture download page)

[/size][u]How to install a portraits mod with Portraiture:[/u]

- Download and install Portraiture for your version of SDV
(If done correctly the manifest.json should now sit in "/Mods/Portraiture/manifest.json")

- Download a portraits mod you want to use.

- Create a folder in "Mods/Portraiture/Portraits" that you name however you like, for ex. "Papaya" and extract the portrait files inside it.
(If done correctly the file for Abigail would be located at "/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Papaya/Abigail.png")

 - Start the game and talk to someone. Once the DialogueBox is open press P to change portraits till you see the right one. It will also shortly show the name of the folder above the left top corner of the DialogueBox, in this case "Papaya". Whatever folder you pick will be saved for all portraits and stay that way after reloading until you change it again yourself.
